what_happened: Dispatch's Item 2 option (ii) claimed the aux_pending chain-state obligation 'is recorded in the multi-task state file, which the planner already reads'; measured that orchestrate-triage-classify.sh (the component that makes the blocked-discharge decision) reads only specs/state.json and a candidate's own .orchestrator-handoff.json per its own documented header, never the per-invocation multi-task state file where aux_pending lives (that file is loaded only inside orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh via mt_get/mt_set). Recommended placing the Item 2 override as post-triage-group post-processing inside orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh instead of inside the classifier script; outcome of option (ii) preserved, ground corrected.
